power.raceapi.haste.name: Haste

power.raceapi.strength.name: Strength
power.raceapi.strength.desc: Your melee attacks deal more damage.
power.raceapi.resistance.name: Resistance
power.raceapi.fire_resistance.name: Fire Resistance

power.raceapi.slowness.name: Slowness
power.raceapi.mining_fatigue.name: Mining Fatigue
power.raceapi.max_health_plus.name: Vitality
power.raceapi.max_health_plus.desc: Your maximum health is increased by 4.
power.raceapi.max_health_minus.name: Frail Body
power.raceapi.max_health_minus.desc: Your maximum health is reduced by 4.
power.raceapi.slow.name: Sluggish
power.raceapi.frail.name: Frail
power.raceapi.frail.desc: Your maximum health is reduced by 40%.
power.raceapi.dash.name: Gale Dash
power.raceapi.dash.desc: Press the active power key to launch yourself forward.
power.raceapi.blink.name: Shadow Blink
power.raceapi.blink.desc: Press the active power key to teleport toward where you look.
power.raceapi.safe_landing.name: Feather Fall
power.raceapi.creative_flight.name: Creative Flight
power.raceapi.creative_flight.desc: You can fly by double-tapping jump.
power.raceapi.toughness.name: Tough Hide
power.raceapi.fire_aura.name: Fire Aura
power.raceapi.fire_aura.desc: Flames surround you and ignite nearby creatures.
power.raceapi.step_height.name: High Step
power.raceapi.step_height.desc: You can climb up full blocks without jumping.
power.raceapi.lifesteal.name: Vampiric
power.raceapi.lifesteal.desc: Melee hits heal you for a portion of the damage dealt.
power.raceapi.double_jump.name: Double Jump
power.raceapi.double_jump.desc: Press the active power key mid-air to jump again.
power.raceapi.night_boost.name: Night Power
power.raceapi.night_boost.desc: At night your melee hits deal more damage.
power.raceapi.day_boost.name: Day Vigor
power.raceapi.day_boost.desc: During the day you move faster.
power.raceapi.light_sensitive.name: Light Sensitivity
power.raceapi.light_sensitive.desc: Open sky during the day sets you on fire.
power.raceapi.ravenous.name: Ravenous
power.raceapi.ravenous.desc: You are constantly hungry and your food bar keeps draining.
power.raceapi.wall_jump.name: Wall Jump
power.raceapi.wall_jump.desc: Kick off walls mid-air to climb higher.
power.raceapi.spider_climb.name: Spider Climb
power.raceapi.spider_climb.desc: You crawl up walls like a spider.
power.raceapi.sprint_jump.name: Running Leap
power.raceapi.sprint_jump.desc: Jumps while sprinting are much higher.
power.raceapi.bouncy.name: Bouncy
power.raceapi.bouncy.desc: Landing from a height bounces you back up instead of hurting.
power.raceapi.frost_touch.name: Frost Touch
power.raceapi.venom_touch.name: Venom Touch
power.raceapi.thorns.name: Thorns
power.raceapi.thorns.desc: Part of incoming damage is reflected back at the attacker.
power.raceapi.heavy_hitter.name: Heavy Hitter
power.raceapi.heavy_hitter.desc: Your hits knock enemies back with great force.
power.raceapi.magnet.name: Magnetism
power.raceapi.magnet.desc: Items and experience orbs are pulled toward you.
power.raceapi.purified.name: Purified
power.raceapi.purified.desc: You are immune to poison and wither.
power.raceapi.detector.name: Keener Sight
power.raceapi.detector.desc: Nearby creatures glow so you can see them through walls.
power.raceapi.aqua_haste.name: Aqua Haste
power.raceapi.aqua_haste.desc: You mine blocks faster while underwater.
power.raceapi.frost_aura.name: Frost Aura
power.raceapi.frost_aura.desc: The space around you chills and slows enemies.
power.raceapi.hyper_inertia.name: Hyper Inertia
power.raceapi.hyper_inertia.desc: You accelerate slowly and lose all momentum on sharp turns.
power.raceapi.density_anchor.name: Density Anchor
power.raceapi.density_anchor.desc: You sink instantly in water, take 2.5x fall damage, but are immune to knockback.
power.raceapi.airborne_fragility.name: Airborne Fragility
power.raceapi.airborne_fragility.desc: Any damage taken while airborne is doubled and slams you to the ground.
power.raceapi.directional_exposure.name: Directional Exposure
power.raceapi.directional_exposure.desc: Attacks from behind deal 75% more damage.
power.raceapi.metal_intolerance.name: Metal Intolerance
power.raceapi.metal_intolerance.desc: Metal armor and tools reduce your maximum health.
power.raceapi.inverse_regeneration.name: Inverse Regeneration
power.raceapi.inverse_regeneration.desc: Potions and natural healing deal damage instead of healing.
power.raceapi.thermal_shock.name: Thermal Shock
power.raceapi.thermal_shock.desc: Rapidly switching between hot and cold environments causes debilitating shock.
power.raceapi.life_tether.name: Life Tether
power.raceapi.life_tether.desc: When a nearby ally dies, you lose health and are slowed.
power.raceapi.conditional.name: %s: %s
power.raceapi.effect_removal.name: Immune: %s
power.raceapi.effect_removal.desc: You are immune to the %s effect.
power.raceapi.action_restriction.name: Action Restriction
race.raceapi.arachnid.name: Arachnid
race.raceapi.arachnid.desc: Crawls up walls like a spider, kicks off walls and injects venom into its prey — but its body is fragile and easily wounded.
race.raceapi.colossus.name: Colossus
race.raceapi.colossus.desc: A walking fortress: grown to giant size, crushes foes with heavy hits and reflects damage with thorns. But it is slow, and its hunger never fades.
race.raceapi.dryad.name: Dryad
race.raceapi.dryad.desc: A child of the forest: moves faster by day, digs nimbly underwater, its body is pure of poisons and wounds slowly heal.
race.raceapi.frost_warden.name: Frost Warden
race.raceapi.frost_warden.desc: Born from glacial ice: every strike freezes, a frost aura spreads around, and falls turn into bounces. But it moves slowly, like an iceberg.
race.raceapi.hare.name: Hare
race.raceapi.hare.desc: Fast and elusive: leaps from a running start, bounces off the ground like a ball, steps easily over blocks and never tires.
race.raceapi.miner.name: Miner
race.raceapi.miner.desc: A sturdy digger: mines twice as fast, pulls loot toward itself and steps easily over ledges — but heavy and slow when running.
race.raceapi.night_owl.name: Night Wanderer
race.raceapi.night_owl.desc: Eyes accustomed to darkness: sees in pitch darkness, strikes harder at night and senses creatures through walls.
race.raceapi.phantom.name: Phantom
race.raceapi.phantom.desc: A child of the night: slips through shadows, dashes forward, jumps again in mid-air and strikes harder in darkness. But daylight burns it — yet its body is pure of poisons.
race.raceapi.shadow_stalker.name: Shadow Stalker
race.raceapi.shadow_stalker.desc: A hunter of darkness: phases through strikes, reflects them with kinetics and sees through the dark. But daylight burns it, and its body is fragile.
power.raceapi.kinetic_slam.name: Kinetic Slam
power.raceapi.kinetic_slam.desc: Slam the ground from above, dealing AoE damage.
power.raceapi.time_trace.name: Time Trace
power.raceapi.time_trace.desc: Mark a position, return to it later.
power.raceapi.phase_dash.name: Phase Dash
power.raceapi.phase_dash.desc: Dash through entities and thin walls.
power.raceapi.kinetic_counter.name: Kinetic Counter
power.raceapi.magnetic_hook.name: Magnetic Hook
power.raceapi.magnetic_hook.desc: Pull yourself to walls or enemies to you.
power.raceapi.life_link.name: Life Link
power.raceapi.life_link.desc: Link to a target, share 40% of damage for 5s.
power.raceapi.gravity_pulse.name: Gravitational Pulse
power.raceapi.gravity_pulse.desc: Hold to charge, release to push/pull. Shift = push.
power.raceapi.overdrive.name: Overdrive
power.raceapi.overdrive.desc: Toggle: +80% speed, fire trail, but costs HP.
power.raceapi.disarm_wave.name: Disarm Wave
power.raceapi.disarm_wave.desc: Seismic wave that disarms and launches enemies.
power.raceapi.teleport_strike.name: Teleport Strike
power.raceapi.teleport_strike.desc: Teleport to the nearest entity you look at, dealing damage and applying Nausea.
power.raceapi.earthquake.name: Earthquake
power.raceapi.earthquake.desc: AoE slam that damages, knocks up and slows nearby enemies. Deals self-damage.
power.raceapi.shadow_step.name: Shadow Step
power.raceapi.shadow_step.desc: Teleports forward along your crosshair up to %s blocks, stopping before walls. If a creature stands near the landing point - backstab damage and Weakness.
power.raceapi.size_control.name: Size Control
power.raceapi.size_control.desc: Changes your character size on key press.
power.raceapi.reach.name: Arm Length
power.raceapi.reach.desc: Modifies how far you can interact with blocks and entities.
power.raceapi.damage_immunity.name: Damage Immunity
power.raceapi.damage_immunity.desc: You are immune to a type of damage.
power.raceapi.grant_item.name: Starter Item
power.raceapi.grant_item.desc: You receive an item when you select this race.
power.raceapi.summon.name: Summon
power.raceapi.summon.desc: Press the active power key to summon creatures near you.
power.raceapi.on_interact.name: On Interact
power.raceapi.on_interact.desc: Right-clicking blocks or entities triggers an effect.
raceapi.command.validate.ok: RaceAPI: all races and powers are valid.
power.raceapi.resource.name: Resource Pool
power.raceapi.resource.desc: Grants a %s-unit resource pool regenerating %s/s. Active powers with a cost spend it.
power.raceapi.resource.desc_stamina: Grants a %s-unit stamina pool regenerating %s/s. Drained by sprinting and melee attacks; active abilities spend it too.
